scope: Static control-flow traces of pinned public source; no third-party code execution

cases.input: Nonzero message IDs A, B, A, with no concurrency
cases.derived_result: All three pass a comparison against only the immediately preceding ID; this is not durable deduplication.
cases.not_proven: No claim that this sequence was observed on WeChat.

cases.input: Two distinct messages have ID 0, same type and identical first 64 UTF-8 content bytes; initial fingerprint differs.
cases.derived_result: The second is suppressed by the previous fingerprint even when the peer or later bytes differ.
cases.not_proven: No real identity or content was read; invented input only.

cases.input: 129 distinct accepted IDs captured sequentially without ProcessPending in between; initial readIdx/writeIdx are zero.
cases.derived_result: Capture 129 overwrites slot 0 containing capture 1. The consumer reads slot 0's newer content on its first iteration; the first event is lost.
cases.not_proven: This scheduling is a static counterexample, not measured throughput or runtime failure.

cases.input: DoSend returns without a caught structured exception.
cases.derived_result: CallDoSend returns 1 without propagating DoSend's internal result; no server message ID or recipient receipt is established.

cases.input: Coro thread capture takes 10 seconds and native completion occurs 28 seconds after enqueue, beyond the UI client's 35-second wait.
cases.derived_result: The outer client can time out while the native operation remains in flight. It has no request cancellation/ID and releases the local semaphore. Late completion must be classified unknown, not safely unsent.
cases.qualification: The inner Seh_Wait does clear pending upon its own timeout. That does not retroactively cancel a request already taken by DrainThunk, and outer timeout does not imply inner timeout. This is not a reproduced client issue.

cases.input: A popped message fails protobuf encoding or nng_send.
cases.derived_result: The inspected callback continues or logs the error without restoring the popped item. No durable acknowledgement/replay contract is established.

send_semantics.result: ret=0/success assigned after void SendText; not recipient delivery
Nonempty text and receiver followed by send_text return cause status=0; no per-send receipt
Internal return ignored; success=1 assigned; not recipient delivery
